validations.rule: candidates were generated from all 6 lenses across the abstraction rungs BEFORE any gating
each surviving wedge cleared the legal/reg gate (no missing license, not ToS-violating)
each survivor names a seam vs incumbents + generic tools
each survivor cites a timing catalyst
each survivor has a defensible edge, not pure commodity
each survivor maps to an asset/skill/channel the operator has
uncertain gates killed or flagged for escalation, never silent-passed

mechanical_validations.rule: output is a Wedge[] matching io-contracts (id, idea_ref, abstraction_rung, lens_origin, description, opening, gate_scores, rank)
an empty array is VALID and means no opening found (must be explicit, not an error)
